verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions only that Godot can be used with external text editors (docs-18) and that GDScript is 'gradually typed' (docs-1), but nothing documents an official Language Server Protocol implementation, typed API/interface definitions, or first-class editor-attach tooling for completions/diagnostics/navigation that a coding agent could use. Missing for 10: explicit mention of GDScript LSP server, typed API/stub generation, or any first-party documentation of machine-consumable API definitions.
